args.subject: Correction of Incorrect Billing & Refund Issued
args.body:
Dear Contoso Ltd,

We have identified and corrected an error in your billing for last month. Your account was incorrectly billed under a non-PLATINUM tier. The correct plan tier, **PLATINUM-QSKB**, has been applied retroactively.

A refund of **175** has been issued to your account (reference: auto-12345). You should see this credit within 1-2 business days. If you have any questions, reply to this email or contact support.

Thank you for your patience.

Best regards,
IT Operations Team
